the likely-working P4 mail preset: --p4-link with --p4-data body, ladder none, normal-ack parity, chirp-ack parity, hold 16, entry timeout 20, long cycles and the QRM guard off; a fetching mail client (plus --send delivery if --send is absent); --level p4-bench unless given. Explicit flags and later --modem-arg words override. Refused with --p4-chirp-counter
experimental mail starting at SL1 with the B +3.125 ms reply timing, continued through turn changes; fetch, optionally upload with --send
experimental PTC-II-style mail: P1 setup/fallback, P2 maximum, 0x6A9 entry at SL1, +18.75 ms P2 phase; never enters P3
the only configuration that has moved mail from this station: stay in P1, announce nothing, open on the call phase. Forgoes P3 entirely
omit every generated --mail-* flag, for an arm with no mail client (e.g. a --p4-probe-* --modem-arg probe). Conflicts with --send and the mail presets
take the turn rather than wait for a greeting the peer cannot send while we hold it
PACTOR-3 phase drive (the modem's --tx-drive); default: the --level's own figure
PACTOR-1 phase drive (the modem's --p1-drive); default: the --level's own figure
go off the air for M cycles after every N unanswered calls (4,6 flew until 2026-09-23); default: call every cycle, as an SCS PTC does
live-link retry limit (modem default 8); separate from connect --retries and the hold budget
key the SCS Robust Connect (the host's `C %%CALL`) rather than the ordinary call
with --robust, key the remaining retries as an ordinary connect after N unanswered robust calls

after the answered call: arq runs the link; listen keys nothing; chirp runs the P4 entry probe from the answer; p1-robust follows with the robust short probe (implied by --p4-link, the only one that can still carry mail)
with --after-connect listen, peer cycles to read before teardown (default %(default)s)
stop when the ARQ gives up instead of listening out the hold (what assessed arms flew)
never offer the upgrade; the session stays on 1400/1600 Hz and the channel sense judges only 1200-1800 Hz. Drops the assessed profile's grant flag
advertise nothing and go up anyway (--p3-uninvited in place of the grant flag). The uninvited entry opens at SL3; --entry-sl 1 removes that confound
which phase opens the link; call moved four messages at KB5LZK on 09-11 (P1-only or P4-entry arms)
announce P1 bits45=1 and select 0x6A9 as the entry response
the announcement's leading digit, the 1990 level declaration (default %(default)s)
function blocks after the announcement, each a code and its parameters ('A 3' 'B')
acknowledged packets between --p1-supervisor blocks (default %(default)s)
function B with our call in every Nth idle P1 packet (try 10; default 0, off)
speed level an UNINVITED P3 entry opens at (default %(default)s); a granted one always opens at 1. All 27 uninvited entries on record opened at 3, which voids them
answer the peer's P3 changeover with a PACTOR-1 codeword in the P3 answer slot (a P1 CS1 made a banner cross at KB5LZK, WS8EOC, VE1YZ)
allow the fall back to PACTOR-1
auto requests a higher P3 speed after three consecutive cycles delivering new payload; hold never asks (default %(default)s)
the ISS's speed and cycle policy (--p3-speed-policy): current is the flown ladder; stock follows the SCS manual's ISS and is unflown (default %(default)s)
SCS MAXTry: speed-up trial transmissions (1..9, default %(default)s)
SCS MAXDown: consecutive receive errors before asking for a lower speed (2..30, default %(default)s)
unflown: a CS4 acknowledges only an odd packet counter; on an even one it asks for the packet again (the IRS in PIII_Complete_1)
outbound P3 trial: a repeated CS5 retains the pending packet
unflown, P3 mail: key IRS control signals N ms later than the reply clock (default %(default)s)
on by --p3-mail: send the terminal marker after the QRT ACK and await opposite ACK parity
enable long cycles (default with --p4-mail)
keep the modem timing guard (default on; --p4-mail turns it off unless given); --no-qrm-guard permits bursts crossing predicted peer reply slots

run the experimental P4 turn machine after robust shorts. Implies --after-connect p1-robust, --p1-status-bits45 2, robust shorts 7,38 on headers A,A (consecutive), --p1-robust-stall 12 then goodbye and --no-observe-after-link-down; admits a mail client (--send, or the default fetch). Explicit flags and later --modem-arg override
the P4 waveform ladder (default long; none with --p4-mail while data is body); none sends a body then normal frames and needs --p4-data body
the data policy each turn keys (default none)
opening and first body response train policy (default %(default)s)
ack for peer normal frames: v27, x27, parity, x27-u27 or alternate-packet (default v27; parity with --p4-mail)
control-word carrier placement: off (legacy zero offsets), stock (measured offsets from body); default off.
experimental ack policy for peer robust long frames (default fixed-x27)
Latin-1 text keyed after our SID; runs only with --no-mail
session ceiling in seconds (default %(default)s)
idle cycles before the hold gives up (default 6; 16 with --p4-mail)
key nothing for N peer cycles from the first IRS greeting body or ladder short (default %(default)s, off)
our answer after a peer short, body or normal packet onset (default %(default)s)
how we ask a sending peer for the turn: an idle 0x40 body, or a bare Y27 that waits for its grant (default %(default)s)
PACTOR-4 chirp entry after a grant; no mail or connected ARQ
P4 setup/ARQ counter challenge: three chirps (same counter twice, then advance); not a mail transfer. Keys the modem's --p4-mail; refused with --p4-link
maximum chirps after a grant (default %(default)s)
post-grant probe deadline in seconds: at most 60 (default 60) for a probe-only arm, 120 (default 120) with --p4-link
what the probe keys: chirp (SL1's 3.3 s entry), short (793 ms) or robust (the setup tape's caller packet, 759 ms); default %(default)s
status bytes to key, one chirp each: one to four, comma separated (e.g. 0x63,0x60,0x61); replaces --p4-entry-attempts
latin-1 text keyed in the chirp field; empty by default
with --p4-probe-packet robust, datablock values 0..63, one packet each (one to four); replaces --p4-entry-attempts
header word per value; 'alt' alternates A,B (default all A). With --p4-link or --p4-mail, a single A or B applies to every value
spaced keys each packet after a full receive window (default); consecutive keys them back to back, as the setup tape's caller did

after the robust answer: listen keys nothing; p2 (default) sends our callsign in P2 and waits for the P3 grant; p1 a P1 packet opening with our call; p3 the SL1 entry and P3 ARQ; p4-robust the robust shorts (6,9,8 on header A unless --p4-probe-values)

fields.help: where the control burst sits in its slot: audio-start is the modem's default (3 of 3 against 0 of 43 for pulse-center on the roster, confounded with the hour)
repeat adds the 22nd symbol every measured SCS control sends
5 ms half-symbol carrier stagger, alternating from this foot. The wrong foot is worse than off: fly one arm on each
hold every P3 data packet and control burst to this peak-to-average ratio in dB (--p3-crest-limit); 6 is the reviewed point and raises average power: watch ALC and PA temperature. Unflown
P3 receive timing: A keeps current placement; B rotates the entry phase by 600 ms. 12 reply opportunities / 20 s
P3 entry acquisition: A uses zero delay; B the default 4.875 ms. Stops at P3 acquisition or 20 s from first entry
with --timing-trial B, shift the reply grid by this many ms (3.125 targets entry +603.125 ms)
with --timing-trial, receive without experiment or hold cutoffs until peer QRT, turn change, link loss or operator stop
fly the snapshot this frozen manifest describes; refuse the arm, before the rig is claimed, if the interpreter resolves anything else

hand this to the launcher unchanged, after every generated word, so a later word overrides (repeatable, unchecked). A flag and its value are one word (--modem-arg '--over-continue long'); a lone flag needs the equals form (--modem-arg=--no-mail-fetch)

go through the list N times; a station that answers is dropped and the remaining passes go where the answer is still unknown

bypass the measured busy status; every other guard stands
key the rig
print the command and stop

place this receiver rather than the nearest free one
